scores.evidence: I took "multi-tenant SaaS billing system" to mean a billing platform sold as SaaS to many businesses (tenants).
scores.rationale: It resolves the ambiguity explicitly, covers core capabilities, and gives explicit, reasoned non-goals and deferrals with triggers.

scores.evidence: All money-affecting state changes are single Postgres transactions inside one module call chain
scores.rationale: Ownership, data flows and consistency choices are applied consistently across components, flows and decisions, with no notable contradictions.

scores.rationale: Early spikes target the riskiest assumptions, domain-specific tests (golden, property, shadow re-rating, invariants, ground-truth load checker) are used, and checks continue in production. Some thresholds are invented but labeled as assumptions.

scores.evidence: If a call times out, the attempt becomes `unknown`. Nothing retries it until the reconciler has looked it up in Stripe.
scores.rationale: Covers unknown payment outcomes, duplicates, out-of-order webhooks, tax outage, worker crash, poison records, key theft, insider access and card testing, each with detection and recovery.

scores.evidence: Alerts tied to what users notice, each linked to a runbook
scores.rationale: Covers deployment with auto-rollback, expand/contract migrations, kill switches, meaningful alerts, on-call rotation, a billing-day staffing plan, restore drills and ownership, all sized to a 6-person team.

scores.rationale: Run costs are given as ranges with controls, and build-vs-buy is noted. Build staffing cost and tax fees are thin and the scaling cost curve is lightly covered.

A modular monolith with a single separate ingest service is well justified, but Kinesis plus Firehose, Datadog, Auth0 and a hash-chained audit log add some weight at launch scale.

RLS enabled and forced ... app_rw, which has no BYPASSRLS ... tenant A tries every endpoint with tenant B's IDs
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, event_id, event_date) DO NOTHING ... prior-period adjustment ... nightly sample: usage_hourly vs recomputation from raw
Catalog with immutable price versions ... proration by seconds within each segment ... anchors on the 29th–31st, daylight saving

note: Exceptionally thorough, coherent and actionable billing platform plan with explicit assumptions, early spikes, and domain-correct money, ledger and idempotency handling. Weaker areas are cost depth and some launch-time complexity, and it treats tax and the buy option mostly as conditional branches.
